release_notes:
1. Professional 2-Column Grid Architecture: Integrated PrestaShop native responsive grid (col-lg-3 sidebar, col-lg-9 content area) ensuring 100% reliable side-by-side panel rendering.
2. Elevated Cards Design: Every configuration group is housed in distinct, elevated card containers with headers, clean borders, and dedicated Save buttons.
3. Dedicated Product Catalog Strategy Panel: Separated catalog identifier matching into its own prominent menu panel featuring interactive 3-card selection.
4. Zero-Cache CSS Embedding & Query-String Busting: Embedded critical layout styles in the template and appended dynamic ?v= query strings to all admin asset calls to prevent stale browser cache issues.
